# One probe per line: VBA statements, then ``;;``, then the expression
# whose answer is recorded.  Each probe gets a freshly added blank
# slide, so nothing leaks from the probe before it.
#
# Measured in live PowerPoint by ``python scripts/measure_vba_semantics.py
# powerpoint`` and replayed against the in-memory model by
# tests/test_powerpoint_model.py.

# --- the application and what it holds ---
;; TypeName(Application)
;; Application.Name
;; TypeName(ActivePresentation)
;; TypeName(ActivePresentation.Slides)
;; TypeName(ActivePresentation.Slides(1))
;; ActivePresentation.Slides.Count > 0
;; ActivePresentation.Slides(1).SlideIndex
;; TypeName(ActivePresentation.PageSetup)
;; ActivePresentation.PageSetup.SlideWidth
;; ActivePresentation.PageSetup.SlideHeight
;; ActivePresentation.Saved

# --- slides ---
;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.SlideIndex
ActivePresentation.Slides.Add ActivePresentation.Slides.Count + 1, 12 ;; ActivePresentation.Slides(ActivePresentation.Slides.Count).Layout
ActivePresentation.Slides.Add ActivePresentation.Slides.Count + 1, 12 ;; ActivePresentation.Slides(ActivePresentation.Slides.Count).Shapes.Count
;; ActivePresentation.Slides(1).Name
;; TypeName(ActivePresentation.Slides(1).Shapes)

# --- shapes on a slide ---
;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.Count
;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 20, 100, 50).Name
;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape(5, 10, 20, 100, 50).Name
;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape(9, 10, 20, 100, 50).Name
;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddTextbox(1, 10, 20, 100, 50).Name
;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddLine(10, 20, 100, 50).Name
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape(1, 0, 0, 10, 10).Name
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.Count
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; TypeName(ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes(1))
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes(1).Type
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddTextbox 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes(1).Type
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddLine 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes(1).Type
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes(1).Left
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes(1).Top
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes(1).Width
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes(1).Height
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes(1).ZOrderPosition
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes(1).AutoShapeType
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 20, 100, 50).Name = "Box" ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes("Box").Left
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 20, 100, 50).TextFrame.TextRange.Text = "Hi" ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes(1).TextFrame.TextRange.Text
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 20, 100, 50).Left = 40 ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes(1).Left
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50: ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes(1).Delete ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.Count
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes("NoSuchShape").Name
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes(2).Name
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes(1).HasTextFrame

# --- the macro a click runs ---
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes(1).ActionSettings(1).Action
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes(1).ActionSettings(1).Run
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 20, 100, 50).ActionSettings(1).Run = "Go" ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes(1).ActionSettings(1).Run
ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 20, 100, 50).ActionSettings(1).Action = 8 ;; ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes(1).ActionSettings(1).Action
;; TypeName(ActiveWindow.View.Slide.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 20, 100, 50).ActionSettings(1))
